summary_1line: Bhishma warns Duryodhana that Krishna and Arjuna are the divine pair Nara and Narayana, recounting their ancient deeds and foretelling Kaurava destruction.

image_candidates.scene_text: In Brahma’s celestial court, gods and sages watch as the radiant ascetics Nara and Narayana rise and depart, drawing every mind toward them.
Arjuna on a whirling chariot releases a broad-headed arrow that severs the head of the Asura Jambha as the demon lunges to swallow him.
Krishna and Arjuna stand together on a single chariot, conch and discus gleaming beside the drawn Gandiva as Bhishma warns the Kauravas.
